architecture.memory: Memory Graph v12 with explicit domain/context identity; Runtime materializes only Main-explicit Memory activation.
architecture.runtime: Mechanical truth, safety, persistence, Evidence/Material, Coverage/Frontier, per-call context safety, provider-reported per-message token budget, transactions
architecture.adapter: Deterministic transport-only DeepSeek V4 profile on port 8080; fixed configured model, JSON Output, direct thinking/max_tokens translation, one format-only repair, provider usage aggregation; no discovery/probing/negotiation

contracts.wire: Main emits tolerant simple wire; Eyle canonicalizes and semantically validates strict ECC locally.
contracts.memory: Memory remains current-by-default semantic knowledge with preserved revision history. Task Memory reuses ordinary mem-* nodes/relations. Semantic supports are revision-pinned when created; source revision drift is exposed mechanically, never interpreted as falsity.
contracts.recall: FTS5/SQL candidate discovery is literal/mechanical. scope=all reaches user + current world; scope=global reaches all current nodes across every world. Exact selections are DB-cursor paged and Main judges relevance.
contracts.frontier: Frontier is exact continuation after the current materialized page, never a semantic reading limit.
contracts.adapter: Adapter remains semantically blind and deterministic: static handshake, fixed configured DeepSeek V4 profile/model, json_object structured transport, direct reasoning/output translation, no remote model discovery or runtime capability negotiation.
contracts.execution: Each user-message execution owns its pending gates and provider-token ledger. Human wait is not charged as a cognitive deadline; the 50000-token context window is enforced per physical LLM call, while provider-reported usage.total_tokens is accumulated across all calls and Adapter internal attempts under the 150000-token per-message budget. If billable usage becomes unknown, further paid calls stop fail-closed.
contracts.source: workspace and eyle are physical source identities, never inferred semantically.
contracts.interaction: Main authors semantic choices; Runtime owns physical confirmations. Both use persisted user gates and a common UI, but only physical confirmation authorizes an exact prepared mutation.
contracts.sandbox_promotion: A tested sandbox file/subtree can be frozen as a hash-bound durable staging artifact and promoted to the real workspace with one exact confirmation; merge does not delete unrelated target files and mirror is explicit.
contracts.context_hygiene: Deterministic ContextMaterializer pages conversation, observations and explicit Memory activations by physical token budget. No fixed semantic item ceiling or automatic Memory projection is part of the runtime.
contracts.task_memory: A task is an ordinary kind=task Memory node. Runtime maintains only active/blocked/resolved/cancelled lifecycle state and state revisions; task relations and semantic content remain Main-authored. Task Memory never creates a recall boundary.
contracts.provenance: Memory/relation support freezes the exact referenced source revision. Revision history exposes changeset execution/turn and revision-specific anchors. A later source revision is reported as source_revised, not semantically invalidated.
contracts.optimization: Optimization remains monotonic: compact presentation may reduce prompt cost, but no physical Material, Evidence, Frontier, or Memory becomes unreachable to Main.
contracts.investigation_quality: Structural inventory is orientation, not sufficient evidence for behavioral/architectural analysis. Main is instructed to inspect representative implementation before concluding material claims.

release_notes.canonical_paths: One responsibility has one canonical implementation path; compatibility facades and runtime promotion branches are removed.
release_notes.config: Runtime accepts only Rev3.7.2 configuration identity. Historical configuration is not promoted in-process.
release_notes.memory: Runtime accepts only Memory Graph v12. The one-shot v11→v12 migrator lives under eyle.devtools and is not on the runtime path.
release_notes.standard_provider: The bundled provider is the canonical eyle.providers.standard package; workspace transaction and sandbox promotion live inside that domain.
release_notes.execution: Dead cognitive-deadline/generated-token aliases are removed; provider usage remains the token authority.
release_notes.context: Fixed message snapshot limits and automatic temporary-memory projection paths are removed.
